description.purpose: A member's memory as a hive (ADR-0002 E1: the hive is the source of truth of a MEMBER; agents are lenses on it): durable episodes (LLM-free write path), a deterministic token-budgeted tier-0 bundle, a five-leg tier-1 retrieval fan (keyword/semantic/graph/temporal/self, the last of them the facts about whoever is ASKING, so a question in the first person reaches them without naming anybody) fused by RRF without an LLM, a tier-2 dialectic answer with a mandatory gap statement, per-turn fact extraction with bi-temporal validity through ONE ingress the answering model writes on, a close pass that reads a whole ended session once on a strong model and sharpens what the per-turn lane could not see, and a nightly delta-scoped consolidation run that supersedes instead of deleting, and an identity round in that same nightly run that judges which relation keys and which entity spellings are the same thing and records the merges as revertible aliases, and a transfer lane that writes everything the hive has accumulated out as a declared, versioned document and takes such a document back into a RUNNING hive idempotently, so a memory is an asset with an identity of its own rather than a side effect of one deployment.
description.use_when: One hive per member whose memory it is; agents are lenses on it (ADR-0002 E1). Wire the lanes AT THE HIVE PATH (`params.ports` is empty) in the SAME mutation that instantiates it -- an island without a crossing edge stays inactive and the cron never spawns. In: in_episode, in_query, in_remember, in_close_pass, in_export, in_import. Out: bundle, close_report, dump, reject. Every write lane needs the provenance of the turn on the ingress context (`audience_set`, `channel`, and `speaker`/`agent_id`) and every read lane needs the asking round (`audience_now`, `channel`); a lane that does not get them refuses rather than guesses.
description.not_in_scope: No skills population and no decay scoring (spec phase 5). Graph anchors still match entity names exactly; the fuzzy index (0.2.0 P4) covers the fact axis, not the graph leg. Nothing merges on similarity alone: the index proposes pairs, the nightly judge decides, and a refusal is remembered so it is not asked again. The embedder is optional: without it recall drops to three legs and writes keep queueing; nothing hard-fails. And no interior address: the store, the dreamer and the glue cells are not endpoints -- a caller names the hive and a lane. And the transfer lane moves CONTENT, not a colony (#37 is the other axis): no machine tables, no embedding configuration, no paging -- a part is a whole table, and a hive whose tables outgrow one message needs the paged form that does not exist yet.
examples: turn -> the HIVE on hop.route == 'in_episode' -> episodes row; later a question on 'in_query' returns that episode inside the bundle that leaves on 'bundle'

audience gate (#244, ADR-0002): every episode carries WHO was present (audience_set, a JSON list in affinity vocabulary), WHO spoke (speaker) and WHERE (channel); facts and entity_edges inherit both from their episode, and beliefs get the INTERSECTION of the audiences of the facts they rest on. A turn without an audience or a channel is refused on 'reject' instead of written untagged
recall tier 1 'nutrition habits' -> semantic leg finds a fact with no lexical overlap, graph leg pulls its episode, RRF ranks both

recall tier 1 'what are my sons called?' -> the question names nobody, so the self leg reads the asker off `audience_now` (its `member:`/`person:` tokens) and nominates the facts about them; the asker also leads the graph anchors, so the walk starts at them instead of at the interrogative words (GH #536)
recall tier 2 -> {answer, gap, sources, confidence}; a model that omits the gap gets gap_missing=true, never a silent answer
cron 03:00 -> dream-glue computes the delta window from consolidation_log -> dreamer verdicts -> supersession (expired_at + superseded_by), never a DELETE

nightly identity round -> two spellings of one relation and two spellings of one person become one axis via set_alias + canonicalize, a look-alike pair is refused via reject_pair, and no written value is ever rewritten

transfer (#243): `in_export` -> 16 parts on `dump`, one per content table, the last carrying export_final='1'; feed each part to another hive's `in_import` and the second hive answers the same recall questions as the first. Applied twice, the document changes nothing the second time -- and a part that lost its `audience_set` on the way is refused rather than written, because an imported row whose participant set did not survive is a row that may be told to anyone

a part IS a seed file: its `schema` header is the store's declaration for that table, so writing `{"schema": ...}` plus one row per line under `store/seed/<table>.jsonl` births a fresh hive from the same document -- with the two store-KEYED tables (aliases, refusals) arriving as `set_alias`/`reject_pair` instead, which is the one thing the birth seeder cannot express
